title: Bigelow buys the ranch and starts NIDS monitoring

tellings.quote: And his story actually was brought to the attention of Robert Bigelow.

plain: In 1996 the businessman Robert Bigelow is said to have bought Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange sightings, after the story of the Sherman family who lived there reached him, and then to have set up monitoring of the land by his private research group, the National Institute for Discovery Science. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's current owner, tells it as the ranch's history passed on to him. If true, it marks the start of serious scientific watching of the place.
